responsibility: This file implements the IPA pass that expands and wires up functions declared with multiple target attributes such as target_clones. It parses and validates attribute lists, creates per-target clone cgraph nodes, chains function-version metadata, generates and installs target-specific dispatchers or ifunc resolvers through target hooks, redirects callers and address references to the dispatcher, and rewrites clone-to-clone calls to choose matching target versions when possible. Its responsibility is callgraph-level multiversioning for target-specific function variants.
